notes.title: It's release day! Are you ready to solve the mystery? 👻🏔️
notes.notes:
🎉 The mysterious White Lady emerges as Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer releases today! 👻 Step into the haunted Alps and uncover the secrets lurking within. Are you ready to solve the mystery? 👻🏔️

notes.title: Update plans
notes.notes:
Now we are totally focused at creating campaigns.

Next update features:

1. 5 Different campaigns for each fraction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/c7634367cbbc3f3d8e1c7b8c26939e480de33427.png[/img]

2. Lot of quests at each campaign. (Not full localization at current moment)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/393d4c0dc783b379507d16eccfe5e0a59e2da49e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/df901a5349bdbcf74e257957000311b78f388e38.png[/img]

3. Massive battles 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/f7acf7b21e021e0b9df1dbc8d69eb38ff3996f8a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/7517e8f4285dc7e79ca89ccb6cb8785b4c4f3e2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/dae636e7c807023da5e96a29ec8d32b2dece487e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/c192a24befa711cf285aa1aa2ed0e7c4617b96a8.png[/img]

4. All campaign crossed by each other so you can look at the events from the different sides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/53602072834cdfc30c03edf6a2e6bbaa28fac23e.png[/img]

5. Reputation system will be rebalanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/1bf016cf6e7d606ee5e7c8fdb347331571474bbb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 13b
notes.notes:
[h2]1. New quests system.[/h2]
Now contains first 5 different quests, which player will get at start of game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/56842dd824601472c5a42155a583e93d4f8ccd47.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/d640fbd88a3712d32db422ac58fc22d3ac981942.png[/img]

[h2]2. Battle upgrades.[/h2]

-Battles can have options:
[list]
[*]Defend of ship
[*]Defend of base
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/112f84adc9b6a0385398fc1feae893037fa4c0f3.png[/img]
[*]Waves of enemies
[*]Destroying by time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/ef46e2c3f51abe3d8686a14cefa3b2c3664624b0.png[/img]
[/list]

-New battle places
[list]
[*]Fire vortexes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/2f5cca5d5b4123ce4ede078029d8571ac2684612.png[/img]
[*]Wins flows
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/0eca37b9f6f3281374b666f50c64389b689a4b8f.png[/img]
[*]Frozen places
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/a5664a80a4e3782d5b8364c036ea6cf6623d67b2.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]3. Global map upgrade.[/h2]
All fleets can move to different places.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/a66610b5d553d62bb147d50e7c9d3eb50ebaeea1.png[/img]

Scouts parameter now have a lot of possibilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/8b70ec3744c8df5c18f5c2ea02aad6c4f270955e.png[/img]

4. Rebalances.
